acceptance_criteria: Traces to its accepted system and software anchors and is verified by its named checks, harness route, or report inspection.
statement: When engineering/run_xcom_benchmarks.py --verify reports/xcom-queue/t036-benchmark.json runs, it shall re-read the report and fail closed (nonzero) when a required field is missing, the method or uncertainty is incomplete, the result is stale or foreign to the candidate, or a two-percent threshold is exceeded.
title: Fail-closed harness verification
